BODU Relational HMI System v75.0

System Documentation — Beyond Our Dreams University, Bishoftu Campus

🏫 1. What Is This System?

The BODU Relational HMI System (v75.0) is a comprehensive, cloud-connected academic management platform for Beyond Our Dreams University (BODU), Bishoftu Campus. It manages the complete student lifecycle — from registration and fee payment through grade management, attendance tracking, GPA reporting, multi-role administration, and department head review workflows.

  • Powered by Firebase Firestore for real-time cloud sync across all staff sessions simultaneously — no page refresh needed.
  • All financial figures are in ETB (Ethiopian Birr).
  • Interface available in English, Afaan Oromoo, and Amharic (toggle in the header).
  • Runs from a single HTML file — no installation, server setup, or internet-facing hosting required.
  • Includes a built-in MS Office Suite (spreadsheet editor with .xlsx export) and a Universal Student Search tool accessible from the top navigation.
🔐 2. Who Uses This System?
  • Admin (Button 08) — Full system control: manage all data, set/change all passwords, configure grade scale, manage fee structures, view audit log, export full database.
  • Registrar (Button 05) — Manage department permission matrix, control grade upload windows, oversee attendance records, view audit log, send department messages, manage staff passwords.
  • Cashier (Button 03) — Process and approve student payment requests, collect tuition fees, view auto-filled fee amounts per student.
  • Finance Head (Button 04) — Configure fee structures (universal, new-student, per-dept/level matrices), view full payment ledger, send fee notices to students.
  • Dept Head (Button 07) — Review pending teacher grade submissions for their department; approve or reject submissions and forward approved grades to the Registrar.
  • Teacher (Button 06) — Upload Score File (A) and Grade File (B) for their assigned department and semester, after the Registrar grants upload permission.
  • Student (Button 02) — View semester grades and cumulative GPA, print an official GPA report with verification code, and submit payment requests to the Cashier.
  • Server Access (Button 09) — Reserved for authorised technical personnel; provides direct data import/export and system-level operations.
🎓 3. Student Grade Portal — Step by Step
  • Step 1 — Enter your Student ID (e.g. 070/23) and press Next.
  • Step 2 — Select your Classification (Regular, Extension, Weekend, Distance, Summer).
  • Step 3 — Select your Level of Education (Diploma, Degree, Masters, PhD).
  • Step 4 — Select your Department.
  • Step 5 — Select your Academic Year (Year 1 – Year 5).
  • Step 6 — Select your Semester. Only semesters containing your data will appear.
  • Step 7 — View your results — subject name, letter grade, credit hours, grade point, and cumulative GPA.
  • Step 8 — Tap Print Your GPA Results for an official A4 report complete with the registrar signature line and a unique verification code.
📦 4. Core System Modules
  • 🎓 General System: Course List, Grade Table, Student List, Credit Hours manager, Student Grade Portal, and Universal Student Search.
  • 🗄️ Database Viewer: Inspect all live data tables in real time; export the full database as a JSON backup.
  • 📋 Registration: New student intake and re-registration workflows, with separate databases for Diploma, Degree, Masters, and PhD levels.
  • 📝 Registrar's Office: Department permission matrix, grade upload control windows, per-department deadlines, attendance management, audit log, inter-department messaging, and staff password management.
  • 💰 Finance: Fee structure configuration (universal, new-student, and per-department/level matrices), full payment ledger, cashier approval queue, and student self-service payment portal.
  • 👩‍🏫 Teacher Grade Upload: Teachers upload Score File (A) and Grade File (B) per department and semester after the Registrar grants permission and within the set deadline.
  • 🏛️ Dept Head Review: Department heads review pending teacher submissions, approve or reject them with comments, and forward approved grades to the Registrar for final posting.
  • 🖥️ MS Office Suite: Built-in spreadsheet editor with formula support and Excel (.xlsx) export — accessible from the bottom toolbar.
  • 🔍 Universal Search: Admins and Registrars can search any student by ID and view their full academic profile, grades, attendance, and payment history in one place.
📊 5. GPA Calculation & Academic Status

Formula: GPA = Σ(Grade Point × Credit Hours) ÷ Σ(Credit Hours)

A+/A = 4.0  |  B+ = 3.5  |  B = 3.0  |  C+ = 2.5  |  C = 2.0  |  D = 1.0  |  F = 0

The grade scale thresholds (score boundaries for each letter grade) are configurable by the Admin from the Settings panel.

  • 3.50 – 4.00 → EXCELLENT — Outstanding academic performance
  • 3.00 – 3.49 → VERY GOOD — Strong, consistent performance
  • 2.50 – 2.99 → GOOD — Solid academic standing
  • 2.00 – 2.49 → SATISFACTORY — Meets minimum requirements
  • 0.00 – 1.99 → FAIL — Below passing threshold
📤 6. Grade Upload Workflow
  • Step 1 — Registrar Opens Window: The Registrar (Button 05) enables grade upload permission per department and sets an optional deadline via the Dept Permissions panel.
  • Step 2 — Teacher Uploads: The Teacher (Button 06) selects their department, Classification, Level, Year, and Semester, then uploads Score File (A) and Grade File (B) in .xlsx or .csv format and submits for review.
  • Step 3 — Dept Head Reviews: The Department Head (Button 07) sees the pending submission, reviews it, and either approves (forwarding to the Registrar) or rejects it with comments returned to the Teacher.
  • Step 4 — Registrar Commits: The Registrar receives the Dept Head-approved grades and commits them to the official live database, making them visible to students.
  • All four steps are automatically recorded in the Audit Log with user and timestamp.
🔒 7. Security & Data Integrity
  • SHA-256 Password Hashing: All role passwords (Admin, Registrar, Cashier, Finance Head, Teacher, Dept Head, Server Access) are hashed before cloud storage — never stored in plain text.
  • Audit Log: Every login, data upload, grade commit, and payment approval is time-stamped and permanently recorded in Firebase — cannot be deleted by any role.
  • Real-Time Sync: Firebase live listeners push updates to all open sessions simultaneously — no manual refresh required.
  • Verification Code: Every printed GPA report contains a unique official verification code that can be authenticated at the Registrar's Office.
  • Per-Department Deadlines: The Registrar can set individual upload deadlines per department; the system automatically closes upload access when deadlines pass.
  • Each user is solely responsible for keeping their credentials and Student ID confidential.
⚙️ 8. Technical Information
  • Platform: Fully browser-based — works on any modern desktop or mobile browser; no app installation required.
  • Backend: Firebase Firestore (real-time cloud database) — project: rvu-hmi-system.
  • File Support: .XLSX, .XLS, .CSV for grade, score, and student data uploads; JSON for full database export/import.
  • Languages: English, Afaan Oromoo, Amharic — toggle button in the top header bar.
  • Architecture: Single self-contained HTML file — no web server, backend code, or installation needed.
  • Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, Firebase Firestore SDK, SheetJS (xlsx).
  • Navigation: 3-tier HMI — top panel selector → sub-panel tabs → content area.
  • Bottom Toolbar: Quick-access bar with ⚙️ Settings (User Guide), 🖥️ Description, ⚖️ Rules, and 🏠 Home.

⚙ System Settings — User Guide

How to access every part of the BODU HMI System

🧭 How to Navigate the System
• The bottom navigation bar is your main entry point. It contains: Home, ⚙ Settings, Description, and Rules.
• Tap Home to return to the main menu at any time.
• Tap the ⚙ Settings button (bottom bar) to open this guide.
🏠 Main Menu — Panel Access
Button 01 — General System
  Tap it to browse: Course List, Grade Table, Student List, Credits, Student Grade Portal. Select Year → Semester → view data.
Button 02 — Student Grade Portal
  Students enter their Student ID, choose Year & Semester, then tap View GPA Results.
Button 03 — Cashier Office
  Login with the Cashier password. Search a student ID to view and record fee payments.
Button 04 — Finance Head
  Login with the Finance Head password to review all financial records and reports.
Button 05 — Registrar's Office
  Login with the Registrar/Admin password. Manage dept permissions, data, attendance, audit log, messages, and passwords.
Button 06 — Teacher Grade Upload
  Login with the Teacher password. Select your department, fill Step 1 (Classification/Level/Year/Semester), upload Score & Grade files, then submit to department.
Button 07 — Department Head
  Login with your department password. Review pending teacher submissions, approve or reject, then forward to the Registrar.
Button 08 — Admin Panel
  Login with the Admin password. Full system control: data upload, user management, permissions, audit logs, and all settings.
⚙ Grade Scale Settings
To configure score thresholds (A+, A, B+, B, C+, C, D, F):
  1. Open the Admin Panel (Button 08) and log in.
  2. Navigate to Grade Scale inside the admin dashboard to set or update all grade boundaries.
📤 How to Upload Data (Students, Grades, Scores, Credits)
All data uploads are done through the Admin Panel (Button 08):
  • 👤 Students tab — Upload or update the student list.
    Required columns: student id, full name, classification, level, department, year, semester.
  • 📊 Grades tab — Upload letter grades per student per course.
    Required: student id + one column per course (A+, A, B+, B, C+, C, D, F).
  • 📋 Scores tab — Upload numeric scores (0–100) per student per course.
    Required: student id + one column per course.
  • 🎓 Credits tab — Upload course credit hours.
    Required: course, credits (must be 2, 3, or 4).
📌 Upload New vs Update Existing
Upload New: Replaces all existing records for that section with file data.
Update Existing: Merges — updates matching IDs/courses, adds new ones without removing others.
👩‍🏫 Teacher Grade Submission Flow
Step 1 — Open Button 06 (Teacher Grade Upload) and enter the Teacher password.
Step 2 — Select your department from the dropdown. (Only departments permitted by the Registrar will be available.)
Step 3 — Choose Classification, Level, Academic Year, and Semester.
Step 4 — Upload File A (numeric scores) and File B (letter grades) as .xlsx or .csv.
Step 5 — Review the preview table and tap Submit to Department.
Step 6 — The Department Head reviews and forwards to the Registrar for final approval.
📋 Registrar Office — What You Can Do
Open Button 05 and log in with the Registrar or Admin password. Inside the dashboard:
  • 🏛️ Dept Permissions — Enable or disable grade upload per department, set deadlines.
  • 📂 Dept Data — Review pending grade submissions from departments.
  • 📅 Attendance — View and manage attendance records.
  • 📊 Audit Log — Full history of all system actions.
  • 📨 Dept Messages — Read messages sent from departments.
  • 🔑 My Password — Change the Registrar password.
  • 👩‍🏫 Teacher Password — Change the shared teacher password.
📄 File Format Tips
• Accepted formats: .xlsx, .xls, .csv
• First row must be column headers exactly as specified for each upload type.
• Column names are case-insensitive but must match the required names.
• Score values must be numeric (0–100). Grade values must be one of: A+, A, B+, B, C+, C, D, F.
• Credit values must be 2, 3, or 4 only.
• Remove any blank rows or merged cells before uploading.

TERMS OF USE & USER RULES

BODU Relational HMI System — v75.0

📋 1. Authorised Use & Role Access
  • This system is exclusively for registered students and authorised staff of Beyond Our Dreams University, Bishoftu Campus.
  • Access is role-gated by password: Admin, Registrar, Cashier, Finance Head, Dept Head, Teacher, Student (Student ID), Server Access. Using another person's credentials or attempting to access a role above your own is strictly prohibited.
  • All role passwords are stored as SHA-256 hashes in Firebase. Plain-text passwords are automatically migrated on first load. Never share your password verbally or in writing.
  • Unauthorised access may be subject to disciplinary or legal action under applicable Ethiopian law. Every login action is recorded in the Audit Log.
🔐 2. Role Responsibilities
  • Admin: Full system control — grade scale configuration, fee structure management, course credits, student data upload, all passwords, audit log access, database JSON export/backup, and academic calendar settings (years, semesters, curriculum).
  • Registrar: Manages department-level grade upload permissions and deadlines, attendance password, student registration permissions (new intake & re-registration), new/old student registration deadlines, and commits Dept Head-approved grades to the live database. Also manages messages and the permission matrix.
  • Finance Head: Reviews all payment ledger records, fee type configurations, and financial reports. No fee amount may be altered after a payment is approved.
  • Cashier: Searches students by ID, views fee clearance status, and records individual fee payments. Cannot alter fee type configurations.
  • Dept Head: Reviews teacher Score & Grade submissions for their department, approves or rejects uploads, manages the department exam bank, and sets per-department exam attendance thresholds. Must complete review within the Registrar's open window.
  • Teacher: Uploads Score File (A) and Grade File (B) for their assigned courses. Both files must be submitted in a single cycle. Submitting falsified data is a serious academic integrity violation.
  • Student: Accesses the Student Grade Portal using their registered Student ID to view GPA results by academic year and semester, and to submit payment requests for their own fees only.
🎓 3. General System — Data Viewing Rules
  • The General System panel provides access to: Score (Course List), Student List, Grade Table, Credits, and the Student Grade Portal. Data is filtered by Academic Year → Semester → Class → Level → Department.
  • The Score tab displays uploaded course score data per class, level, and department. Only Admin can view all data without a role filter.
  • The Student List tab shows registered students. Admin can add course credits and edit academic configuration. Dept Head and Teacher views are filtered to their department.
  • The Grade tab shows committed grade data. Admin can view and print full tables. Dept Head and Teacher views are scoped to their department.
  • The Attendance tab is protected by a dedicated attendance password set by the Registrar. Attendance records are stored per course, class, level, department, year, and semester.
  • The Student Grade Portal allows any visitor to look up their own GPA results using only their Student ID. Printed GPA reports carry a unique verification code — they are not official documents unless physically stamped and signed by the Registrar.
🏛️ 4. Registration Rules
  • New student registration is only open when the Registrar has enabled it and the registration deadline has not passed. The system enforces this automatically.
  • Old student re-registration requires payment clearance. Students blocked by the Cashier cannot complete re-registration until their fees are settled.
  • Each student may register only once per semester. Duplicate registrations within the same semester are rejected by the system.
  • Re-registration eligibility criteria (minimum GPA, maximum failed subjects, and class assignment) are configured by the Registrar and enforced automatically.
  • Students must not attempt to alter their own registration records. All self-editing is blocked — modifications must go through the Registrar's office.
  • The Database tab (Admin/Registrar only) provides an SQL-style viewer of all Firebase collections. No data may be exported, shared, or published beyond authorised technical personnel.
📝 5. Grade Upload & Exam Center Rules
  • Grade uploads are only accepted when the Registrar has explicitly granted permission for a department. Per-department deadlines are enforced automatically — late uploads are rejected.
  • Teachers must complete both Score File (A) and Grade File (B) in a single submission cycle. Partial uploads are not forwarded to the Dept Head for review.
  • Dept Heads must review and approve or reject teacher submissions within the open window. Delayed approvals causing grade unavailability are the Dept Head's responsibility.
  • The Exam Center is password-protected. The Dept Head manages the Exam Bank (question sets per course), opens/closes live exam sessions, and sets the minimum attendance threshold required for a student to sit an exam.
  • Students who do not meet the attendance threshold for a course are blocked from accessing that exam — this is enforced automatically by the system.
  • Exam results published through the Exam Center are visible to students via the Exam Results portal. The Dept Head controls whether results are open or closed for student viewing.
  • Uploading falsified, manipulated, or altered Score, Grade, or Exam files is a serious academic integrity violation and will be recorded in the Audit Log.
🖨️ 6. Printed Documents, Verification & Audit
  • All printed outputs (GPA reports, grade tables, attendance sheets, score lists) generated by this system carry the BODU seal, a date/time stamp, and a unique verification code. Altering or removing any of these elements is a forgery offence.
  • Verification codes on GPA printouts can be authenticated at the Registrar's Office. Printed reports are for personal reference only until physically stamped and signed by the Registrar.
  • No system output may be reproduced or submitted as an official document without the Registrar's written authorisation.
  • Every significant action in the system (logins, uploads, approvals, rejections, data changes, exports) is recorded in the Audit Log. The Audit Log is read-only for all roles including Admin — it cannot be deleted or altered.
  • The database JSON export/backup feature (Admin only) must not be distributed beyond authorised technical personnel. The export filename includes the system version for traceability.
🚫 7. Prohibited Actions
  • Do not attempt to reverse-engineer, decompile, modify, or tamper with the system's HTML, JavaScript, or Firebase security rules.
  • Do not upload falsified, altered, or manipulated Score, Grade, Student List, or Exam files.
  • Do not share, photograph, screenshot, publish, or distribute another student's academic, financial, or personal records.
  • Do not use the Database viewer, JSON export, or any admin tool for any purpose outside authorised academic administration.
  • Do not attempt to bypass the attendance threshold check to gain access to an exam session you are ineligible for.
  • Do not submit a payment request for another student's fees or attempt to manipulate the payment ledger or clearance status.
  • Do not attempt to alter or delete the Audit Log — it is permanently read-only for all roles.
⚠️ 8. Disclaimer & Liability
  • This system runs entirely in the browser and syncs data live with Firebase Firestore. A stable internet connection is required for all data operations — uploads, saves, and real-time sync.
  • BODU and the system developer accept no liability for data loss resulting from browser clearing, device failure, or network interruption during an active upload or save session.
  • Data displayed in this system is for informational purposes. Always verify critical academic, financial, or registration decisions with the Registrar's Office directly.
  • For grade disputes or correction requests, contact your department instructor or the Registrar's Office — do not attempt to alter records yourself.
  • System availability is subject to Firebase service uptime. Planned maintenance windows will be communicated by the Registrar's Office in advance.
  • The Google Translate feature is provided for accessibility only. The English content is the authoritative version of all system text, rules, and instructions.
By using this system you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to all rules above.
